subject: Trading
title: Silver's Dual Identity
description: A micro-lesson that makes Silver's Dual Identity usable.

hook.text: Silver is both a precious metal and an industrial metal. It can't decide what it wants to be.

buildup.text: Half of silver demand comes from industry—electronics, solar panels, medical devices. The other half is investment.

discovery.text: This dual identity makes silver more volatile than gold. Industrial slowdowns hit silver harder than they touch gold.

twist.text: Silver's gold ratio fluctuates wildly—from 30:1 to 120:1. Traders bet on this ratio reverting to historical norms.

climax.text: Silver amplifies gold's moves—rising more in bull markets, falling harder in bears. It's gold with extra volatility.

punchline.text: Silver is gold's wilder, louder sibling.

quiz.question: Why is silver more volatile than gold?
options: Its price is driven by both industrial demand and investment demand
